verdict.rationale: Stripe Crypto docs show building blocks that can run unattended once configured — recurring stablecoin withdrawals/subscriptions (docs-4, docs-20) and support for the machine-to-machine x402 stablecoin payment protocol (docs-16) — which imply some autonomous background transaction capability for agentic use cases, and an MCP server exists for programmatic/agent access (probe-4). However there is no evidence of a broader automation/workflow engine, scheduling, or AI-agent orchestration layer specifically for setting up autonomous background tasks beyond payments. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of agent-triggered automation workflows, scheduling/orchestration tooling, and independent confirmation that x402/subscription features are used for autonomous background automation in practice.
